mapper.insert: INSERT INTO invoices (id, booking_id, freight_charge_id, amount, due_date, payment_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.bookingId}, #{row.freightChargeId}, #{row.amount}, #{row.dueDate}, #{row.paymentStatus}, #{row.createdAt}, #{row.updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE invoices SET booking_id = #{row.bookingId}, freight_charge_id = #{row.freightChargeId}, amount = #{row.amount}, due_date = #{row.dueDate}, payment_status = #{row.paymentStatus}, updated_at = #{row.updatedAt} WHERE id = #{row.id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, booking_id, freight_charge_id, amount, due_date, payment_status, created_at, updated_at FROM invoices ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
